items.source: Note: In order to use Servlet container based multipart parsing, you need to mark the affected servlet with a "multipart-config" section in web.xml, or with a MultipartConfigElement in programmatic servlet registration, or (in case of a custom servlet class) possibly with a MultipartConfig annotation on your servlet class. Configuration settings such as maximum sizes or storage locations need to be applied at that servlet registration level; a Servlet container does not allow for them to be set at the MultipartResolver level.
items.translation: 注意： 若要使用基于 Servlet 容器的多部分解析，您需要通过在 web.xml 中标记受影响的 servlet 的 "multipart-config" 部分，或在程序化注册 servlet 时使用 MultipartConfigElement，或者（对于自定义 servlet 类）可能在您的 servlet 类上使用 MultipartConfig 注解来配置。诸如最大大小或存储位置等配置设置需要在该 servlet 注册级别应用；Servlet 容器不允许在 MultipartResolver 级别设置这些内容。

items.source: Default is "false", trying to process any request with a "multipart/" content type as far as the underlying Servlet container supports it (which works on, for example, Tomcat but not on Jetty). For consistent portability and in particular for consistent custom handling of non-form multipart request types outside of Spring's MultipartResolver mechanism, switch this flag to "true": Only "multipart/form-data" requests will be wrapped with a MultipartHttpServletRequest then; other kinds of requests will be left as-is, allowing for custom processing in user code.
items.translation: 默认为 "false"，尝试处理任何具有 "multipart/" 内容类型的请求，前提是底层 Servlet 容器支持该功能（例如在 Tomcat 上有效，但在 Jetty 上无效）。为了实现一致的移植性，特别是为了在 Spring 的 MultipartResolver 机制之外对非表单 multipart 请求类型进行一致的处理，请将此标志切换为 "true"：此后仅将 "multipart/form-data" 请求包装为 MultipartHttpServletRequest；其他类型的请求将保持原样，以便在用户代码中进行自定义处理。

items.source: This resolver variant uses your Servlet container's multipart parser as-is, potentially exposing the application to container implementation differences. Also, see this resolver's configuration option for strict Servlet compliance, narrowing the applicability of Spring's MultipartHttpServletRequest to form data only.
items.translation: 此解析器变体直接使用您的 Servlet 容器中的多部分解析器，可能会使应用程序暴露于容器实现差异的风险之下。此外，请参阅此解析器的严格 Servlet 合规性配置选项，将 Spring 的 MultipartHttpServletRequest 接口适用范围限制为仅表单数据。

items.source: Default is "false", resolving the multipart elements immediately, throwing corresponding exceptions at the time of the resolveMultipart(HttpServletRequest) call. Switch this to "true" for lazy multipart parsing, throwing parse exceptions once the application attempts to obtain multipart files or parameters.
items.translation: 默认为 "false"，会立即解析多部分元素，并在调用 resolveMultipart(HttpServletRequest) 时抛出相应的异常。将其切换为 "true" 以启用懒式多部分解析，仅在应用程序尝试获取多部分文件或参数时抛出解析异常。

items.source: Parse the given HTTP request into multipart files and parameters, and wrap the request inside a MultipartHttpServletRequest object that provides access to file descriptors and makes contained parameters accessible via the standard ServletRequest methods.
items.translation: 将给定的 HTTP 请求解析为多部分文件和参数，并将该请求封装在`MultipartHttpServletRequest`对象中，该对象提供对文件描述符的访问，并通过标准的 ServletRequest 方法使包含的参数可访问。
